meta.name: aws-cost-operations
meta.description: This skill provides AWS cost optimization, monitoring, and operational best practices with integrated MCP servers for billing analysis, cost estimation, observability, and security assessment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 监控并优化 AWS 云支出,降低账单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 AWS 账单,想看清钱花在哪并压降成本。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor and optimize AWS cloud spending to cut bills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage AWS bills and want to track and reduce cloud costs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会利用集成的 AWS 工具帮你：估算云服务费用、分析账单趋势、查询监控指标、审计操作日志，并给出优化建议。若这些工具未配置，它会指导你完成配置。
howto.when: 当用户询问 AWS 成本优化、费用估算、监控报警等问题时触发；遇到审计操作记录、安全评估等请求时也会启用。

say.text: 分析这个月的 AWS 账单，找出花费最高的三个服务。
say.note: Claude 会调用账单工具分析数据并汇总。

say.text: 查一下最近24小时内有谁修改过 IAM 角色？

howto.what_en: Claude uses integrated AWS tools to estimate costs, analyze bills, query metrics, audit logs, and suggest optimizations. If tools are missing, it helps configure them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask about AWS cost optimization, cost estimation, monitoring alarms, or request audit and security assessment.

say_en.text: Estimate monthly cost of Lambda in us-east-1: 1M invocations, 512MB, 3s each.
say_en.note: Claude uses the pricing tool to calculate and return an estimate.

say_en.text: Analyze this month's AWS bill and list the top three most expensive services.
say_en.note: Claude queries billing data and summarizes the findings.

say_en.text: Who modified IAM roles in the last 24 hours?
say_en.note: Claude uses CloudTrail to find and list the relevant records.
